title: Zapier holds a batch of runs and nothing happens until someone replays them
symptoms: Zap runs show status Held in Zap history
An import of 100 or more records triggers nothing
Held runs are not picked up by autoreplay
cause: Polling triggers that find 100 or more new items at once are held by flood protection, counted before any Filter or Path step. Runs are also held when tasks run out, a connection is disconnected, or a premium app is not on the plan.
fix: Review and replay held runs from Zap history, raise the flood protection limit on paid plans, and add Delay After Queue for planned bulk loads.
apply: Zap history > filter Status: Held > select runs > Replay
affected: Zapier polling triggers, all plans; manual replay of held runs needs a paid plan, as of 2026-10
